verdict.rationale: Bulk operations across many items, such as batch-processing many prompts or files, is a fair axis for an inference engine. However, the evidence pack documents no such capability. The "prompt ingestion runs fast in batches" comment (comm-11) refers to internal token batching, not user-facing bulk operations. The photo-keywording anecdote (comm-14) is a user-side workaround and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
